name: adsb_feed
status: draft - review before depending on it
doc: Wire format of the ADS-B track feed. Framing follows Nasdaq MoldUDP64 (header + length-prefixed message blocks) with little-endian integers. See protocol/feed_spec.md.

constants.name: kMaxUdpPayload
constants.doc: 1500-byte Ethernet MTU minus IPv4 (20) and UDP (8) headers

constants.name: kEndOfSessionCount
constants.doc: PacketHeader.count marking the end of a session

bitsets.name: UpdateMask
bitsets.doc: TrackUpdate.update_mask: which fields changed in this update

bits.name: kNewTrack
bits.doc: first update for this ICAO address in this session

bits.name: kAltitudeGnss
bits.doc: alt_ft is GNSS height, not barometric

bits.name: kOnGround
bits.doc: aircraft reports being on the ground

bits.name: kNonIcaoAddress
bits.doc: icao is an anonymous / TIS-B track-file address

bits.name: kSurfacePosition
bits.doc: last position came from a surface position message

bits.name: kHeadingTrue
bits.doc: heading_cdeg is relative to true north (TC 31 HRD = 0); clear: magnetic north

bits.name: kAirspeedTrue
bits.doc: airspeed_kt is true airspeed; clear: indicated airspeed

structs.name: PacketHeader
structs.doc: Starts every UDP datagram. Followed by `count` message blocks, each a u16 length then that many bytes.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Publisher session id; changes on every restart. A subscriber that sees a new session resets its state.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Sequence number of the first message in the packet (for a heartbeat: the next sequence number).

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Messages in the packet; 0 = heartbeat, 65535 = end of session.

structs.name: RetransmitRequest
structs.doc: Sent by a subscriber by unicast UDP to the retransmit server (same layout as a MoldUDP64 request packet).

structs.name: TrackUpdate
structs.doc: Full current state of one aircraft track, sent whenever any field changes. Unknown fields hold their `null` value.

fields.name: event_ts_ns
fields.doc: Receive time of the frame that caused this update (event time, ns)

fields.name: radio_ts
fields.doc: Radio timestamp of that frame: Beast 12 MHz counter or own-demodulator sample index; top 4 bits = receiver line id

fields.name: vrate_fpm
fields.doc: Vertical rate, feet per minute (clamped to +-32767)

fields.name: squawk
fields.doc: Mode A code as four octal digits in hex nibbles (7700 -> 0x7700)

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Emitter category, e.g. 0xA3 (set A, value 3); 0 if unknown

fields.name: nic
fields.doc: Navigation integrity category of the current position, 0-11 (0 = unknown or no position)

fields.name: adsb_version
fields.doc: ADS-B version from operational status (TC 31): 0 DO-260, 1 DO-260A, 2 DO-260B; null until one is received (nic is then computed as for version 0)

fields.name: publish_ts_ns
fields.doc: Publisher software timestamp taken just before send (wall-clock domain); 0 inside the pipeline

fields.name: heading_cdeg
fields.doc: Heading, 0.01 degree, [0, 36000), from airborne velocity subtypes 3/4; north reference in flags.kHeadingTrue

fields.name: airspeed_kt
fields.doc: Airspeed, knots, from airborne velocity subtypes 3/4; flags.kAirspeedTrue says TAS or IAS

structs.name: TrackDelete
structs.doc: The track expired or was removed; subscribers drop it.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: 1 = expired (no frames for the timeout), 2 = evicted

fields.name: event_ts_ns
fields.doc: Event time at which the track was removed

structs.name: SnapshotBegin
structs.doc: Starts a snapshot (snapshot server, TCP). Followed by track_count TrackUpdate messages and a SnapshotEnd.

fields.name: track_count
fields.doc: Number of TrackUpdate messages that follow

fields.name: as_of_seq
fields.doc: The snapshot reflects every message with seq <= as_of_seq

fields.name: event_ts_ns
fields.doc: Event time of the last applied message

structs.name: SnapshotEnd
structs.doc: Ends a snapshot. Apply buffered incremental messages with seq > as_of_seq.

fields.name: as_of_seq
fields.doc: Same value as the matching SnapshotBegin

golden_packet.doc: A complete datagram used by every language's tests: header + one TrackUpdate + one TrackDelete.
